# Country scope. Any Americas protagonist axis.
oe_amr_is_protagonist = {

# Country scope. Respects Rule #17 oe_rule_global_arcs_depth (0 new rules!).
oe_amr_country_enabled = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
	}
}

# Any scope. Clean v10.5 Nova Elysia presence detector (zero errors if Elysia never settled).
oe_amr_elysia_present = {
	has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
	any_country = {
		oe_eln_is_elysia = yes
		num_locations > 0
	}
}

# Any scope. Standard Old World European colonizer presence in North America (fallback when Elysia absent).
oe_amr_old_world_in_north_america = {
	any_country = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_eln_is_elysia = yes }
		capital ?= { continent = continent:europe }
		any_owned_location = {
			OR = {
				region = region:east_coast_region
				region = region:canada_region
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. D015/D017 ZERO-DLC soft synergy trigger (verified 1.4.9 spelling tehotihuacan & cholollan!).
oe_amr_holds_sacred_pyramids = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:tehotihuacan
		owns = location:cholollan
	}
}

# Country scope. Holds BOTH D015/D017 sacred pyramid cities.
oe_amr_holds_both_sacred_pyramids = {
